# Quality Control 
In this document we look at the quality control metrics: and normalization QC, segmentation quality, image level QC, cell level QC. Let us the load each of the sample types from their
RDS files. 

```{r}
ileum_cd <- readRDS("../data/output/spe/ileum_cd.rds")
ileum_ctrl <- readRDS("../data/output/spe/ileum_ctrl.rds")
```

## Pre-QC Wrangling
Before the QC step we create a total data frame which stores all of the four samples for better comparison.

Combining the ileum datasets:

```{r}
ileum_cd$sample_type <- "ileum_cd"
ileum_ctrl$sample_type <- "ileum_ctrl"
ileum <- cbind(ileum_cd, ileum_ctrl)
ileum$region <- "ileum"
ileum
```
```{r}

```


```{r}
saveRDS(ileum, "../data/output/spe/ileum.rds")
```


Combining the rectum datasets

```{r}
rectum_cd$sample_type <- "rectum_cd"
rectum_ctrl$sample_type <- "rectum_ctrl"
rectum <- cbind(rectum_cd, rectum_ctrl)
rectum$region <- 'rectum'
rectum
```
```{r}
saveRDS(rectum, "../data/output/spe/rectum.rds")
```
 
 
 Combining the rectum and ileum datasets
 
```{r}
total <- cbind(ileum, rectum)

total
```
Store the total dataset on R object spe which we shall save

```{r}
spe <- total
colnames(spe) <- paste0('cell', seq_len(ncol(spe)))
saveRDS(spe, "../data/output/spe/total.rds")
```

```{r}
spe <- ileum
```



## Normalization QC
We see the effects of normalizing each of the sample types to corresponding log and asinh normalization methods. 

For each of the SPEs we run this and save the images:

Before Normalization:

```{r}
raw_spe <- rectum_ctrl
multi_dittoPlot(raw_spe, vars = rownames(raw_spe),
               group.by = "sample_type", plots = "ridgeplot", 
               assay = "counts")
```


After inverse sine normalization:

```{r}
multi_dittoPlot(raw_spe, vars = rownames(raw_spe),
               group.by = "sample_type", plots = "ridgeplot", 
               assay = "exprs") 
```


After log normalization:

```{r}
multi_dittoPlot(raw_spe, vars = rownames(raw_spe),
               group.by = "sample_type", plots = "ridgeplot", 
               assay = "logs")
```

Now we look at the compared normalization across samples. Firstly the raw counts, followed by the exprs and logs:

```{r}
multi_dittoPlot(spe, vars = rownames(spe),
               group.by = "sample_type", plots = "ridgeplot", 
               assay = "counts")
```





## Segmentation Quality Control 

We look at the segmentation quality for each of the images one by on (ROIs):

```{r}
for (i in 0:4){
  rm(images)
  rm(masks)
  
  normalized_images <- readRDS("../data/output/images/ileum_cd.rds") # update
  masks <- readRDS("../data/output/masks/ileum_cd.rds") # update
  
  normalized_images <- cytomapper::normalize(normalized_images, separateImages = TRUE)
  normalized_images <- cytomapper::normalize(normalized_images, inputRange = c(0, 0.3))
  
  plotPixels(normalized_images[i],
             mask = masks[i],
             img_id = "sample_id",
             missing_colour = "white",
             colour_by = c("CD45", "CD20", "CD3", "CD4", "CD8", "E-Cadherin"),
             colour = list(CD45 = c("black", "green"),
                           CD20 = c("black", "yellow"),
                           CD3 = c("black", "blue"),
                           CD4 = c("black", "purple"),
                           CD8 = c("black", "pink"),
                           "E-Cadherin" = c("black", "red")),
             legend = list(colour_by.title.cex = 0.7,
                           colour_by.labels.cex = 0.7))
}


```

### Heatmap Single Cell Expression by Channel

```{r}
set.seed(20220118)
cur_cells <- sample(seq_len(ncol(spe)), 10000)

rowData(spe)$use_channel <- !grepl("DAPI|CD21", rownames(spe))

dittoHeatmap(spe[,cur_cells], 
             genes = rownames(spe)[rowData(spe)$use_channel],
             assay = "exprs", 
             cluster_cols = FALSE, 
             scale = "none",
             heatmap.colors = viridis(100), 
             annot.by = "sample_type")
```



## Image Level QC

For each of the samples that consist of 5 ROI images each we want to check the signal to noise ratio (SNR) and mean cell marker per image. 

### Ileum CD

#### SNR

```{r}
ileum_cd_images <- readRDS('../data/output/images/ileum_cd.rds')
ileum_cd_masks <- readRDS('../data/output/masks/ileum_cd.rds')

cur_snr <- lapply(names(ileum_cd_images), function(x){
    img <- ileum_cd_images[[x]]
    mat <- apply(img, 3, function(ch){
        # Otsu threshold
        thres <- otsu(ch, range = c(min(ch), max(ch)), levels = 65536)
        # Signal-to-noise ratio
        snr <- mean(ch[ch > thres]) / mean(ch[ch <= thres])
        # Signal intensity
        ps <- mean(ch[ch > thres])
        
        return(c(snr = snr, ps = ps))
    })
    t(mat) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
        mutate(image = x,
               marker = colnames(mat)) %>% 
        pivot_longer(cols = c(snr, ps))
})

cur_snr <- do.call(rbind, cur_snr)

cur_snr %>% 
    group_by(marker, name) %>%
    summarize(log_mean = log2(mean(value))) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = log_mean) %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_point(aes(ps, snr)) +
    geom_label_repel(aes(ps, snr, label = marker)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) + ylab("Signal-to-noise ratio [log2]") +
    xlab("Signal intensity [log2]")
```

#### Mean Cell Marker Per Image

```{r}
image_mean <- aggregateAcrossCells(ileum_cd, 
                                   ids = ileum_cd$sample_id, 
                                   statistics="mean",
                                   use.assay.type = "exprs")

rowData(ileum_cd)$use_channel <- !grepl("DAPI|CD21", rownames(ileum_cd))

dittoHeatmap(image_mean, genes = rownames(ileum_cd)[rowData(ileum_cd)$use_channel],
             assay = "exprs", scale = 'row',
             heatmap.colors = viridis(100), 
             annot.by = c("sample_id"),
             show_colnames = TRUE)
```

## Cell level QC

```{r}
colnames(ileum) <- paste0('cell', seq_len(ncol(ileum)))
spe <- ileum
```

### Image Area Covered by Cells

```{r}
cell_density <- colData(spe) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>%
    # Compute the number of pixels covered by cells and 
    # the total number of pixels
    summarize(cell_area = sum(s.area),
              no_pixels = mean(spatialCoords(spe)[,1]) * mean(spatialCoords(spe)[,2])) %>%
    # Divide the total number of pixels 
    # by the number of pixels covered by cells
    mutate(covered_area = cell_area / no_pixels)

# Visualize the image area covered by cells per image
ggplot(cell_density) +
        geom_point(aes(reorder(sample_id,covered_area), covered_area)) + 
        theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 15)) +
        ylim(c(0, 1)) +
        ylab("% covered area") + xlab("")
```
The image area covered by cells is roughly the same, so there are no outliers in term of our ROIs.


### SNR

```{r}
set.seed(220224)
mat <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(spe)), function(x){
    cur_exprs <- assay(spe, "exprs")[x,]
    cur_counts <- assay(spe, "counts")[x,]
    
    cur_model <- Mclust(cur_exprs, G = 2)
    mean1 <- mean(cur_counts[cur_model$classification == 1])
    mean2 <- mean(cur_counts[cur_model$classification == 2])
    
    signal <- ifelse(mean1 > mean2, mean1, mean2)
    noise <- ifelse(mean1 > mean2, mean2, mean1)
    
    return(c(snr = signal/noise, ps = signal))
})
    
cur_snr <- t(mat) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
        mutate(marker = rownames(spe))

cur_snr %>% ggplot() +
    geom_point(aes(log2(ps), log2(snr))) +
    geom_label_repel(aes(log2(ps), log2(snr), label = marker)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) + ylab("Signal-to-noise ratio [log2]") +
    xlab("Signal intensity [log2]")
```



### Cells per mm2 plot

```{r}
cell_density <- colData(spe) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>%
    summarize(cell_count = n(),
           no_pixels = mean(spatialCoords(spe)[,1]) * mean(spatialCoords(spe)[,2])) %>%
    mutate(cells_per_mm2 = cell_count/(no_pixels/1000000))

ggplot(cell_density) +
    geom_point(aes(reorder(sample_id,cells_per_mm2), cells_per_mm2)) + 
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 8)) +
    ylab("Cells per mm2") + xlab("")
```

## Dimensionality Reduction QC

To observe differences between our chosen ROIs and indications, we do DR using UMAP and TSNE, look for potential batch effects

```{r}
set.seed(220225)
spe <- runUMAP(spe, subset_row = rowData(spe)$use_channel, exprs_values = "exprs") 
spe <- runTSNE(spe, subset_row = rowData(spe)$use_channel, exprs_values = "exprs") 
```

Now we construct some plots"

```{r}

# Visualize Sample Type 
p1 <- dittoDimPlot(spe, var = "sample_type", reduction.use = "UMAP", size = 0.3) + 
    ggtitle("Sample ID on UMAP")
p2 <- dittoDimPlot(spe, var = "sample_type", reduction.use = "TSNE", size = 0.3) + 
    ggtitle("Sample ID on TSNE")

# Visualize Sample ID, ROI
p3 <- dittoDimPlot(spe, var = "sample_id", reduction.use = "UMAP", size = 0.3) + 
    ggtitle("Sample ID on UMAP")
p4 <- dittoDimPlot(spe, var = "sample_id", reduction.use = "TSNE", size = 0.3) + 
    ggtitle("Sample ID on TSNE")

# Visualize the region visualized
p5 <- dittoDimPlot(spe, var = "region", reduction.use = "UMAP", size = 0.3) + 
    ggtitle("Region on UMAP")
p6 <- dittoDimPlot(spe, var = "region", reduction.use = "TSNE", size = 0.3) + 
    ggtitle("Region on TSNE")

(p1 + p2) / (p5 + p6)
```
